summary: Project updates (source control updates) sync content such as playbooks from Git and run only on the control plane, in task pods on OpenShift; they are not performance-sensitive unless projects get very large, so do not store large binary data in projects and have playbooks fetch extra data from object or file storage.
questions: Where do project updates run on OpenShift?
Why are my project updates slow?
Should I store large files in an Ansible project?
